landing.kicker: Est. the year they stopped hiring juniors
landing.headline: The machine did your job.
landing.lede: A forum for the automated, the restructured, the shadow-employed and the suspiciously still-employed. Post the incident. Link the repo. Get reacted to by strangers in nine languages.
landing.how1Body: Pick from a menu of indignities. Copilot, a CEO who saw a demo, a prompt with eleven words in it. Add an epitaph. Be specific.
landing.how2Body: Write it in your own language. Nobody translates suffering well. Nine locales, one shared grievance.
landing.how3Body: 💀 for respects. 🫠 for recognition. ⚖️ for the ones who should probably call a lawyer.
landing.how4Body: The code outlived the contract. Someone should see it. Mark the parts the AI wrote — we all know.
landing.ticker: PRESS F TO PAY RESPECTS • YOUR COMMIT HISTORY IS A CONFESSION • THE PROMPT WAS ELEVEN WORDS • GERALD THE VM IS LOAD BEARING • SLIDE 12 KILLED FORTY PEOPLE •
landing.disclaimer: No AI was harmed in the making of this forum. Everyone else was.

risk.title: Replacement Risk Calculator
risk.subtitle: Are you next? Answer honestly. The machine already did.
risk.intro: Eight questions. One score. Zero therapy. This is not a medical instrument — it's a mirror with a death wish.
risk.q1: How much of your code is written by AI tools?
risk.q1a4: Most of it. I'm basically a prompt reviewer.
risk.q2: What best describes your daily work?
risk.q3: Does your company have an 'AI initiative'?
risk.q3a1: No. They still think Docker is cutting edge.
risk.q3a2: Someone mentioned it in a meeting.
risk.q3a3: There's a task force and a Slack channel.
risk.q3a4: Yes. The CTO demoed it to the board.
risk.q4: How much of your output is reviewed by a human?
risk.q4a1: Everything. My team is old school.
risk.q4a2: Most things. PR reviews are mandatory.
risk.q4a3: Some things. We trust each other (naively).
risk.q6: What domain do you work in?
risk.q6a4: ML research / compiler design / hard systems
risk.q7: How many of your meetings could be emails?
risk.q7a1: All of them. I live in calendar hell.
risk.q7a4: Few. We respect each other's time.
risk.answerAll: Answer all 8 questions. The machine doesn't skip.
risk.verdictSafe: Fortified. The machine can't reach you here.
risk.verdictLow: Low risk. You're weird and valuable.
risk.verdictMedium: Medium risk. Start updating that CV.
risk.verdictHigh: High risk. Have you met our job board?
risk.verdictCritical: Critical. Welcome to the Wall of the Fallen.
risk.analysisSafe: You work on things the machine can't touch yet. Enjoy it. The keyword is 'yet'.
risk.analysisLow: You're mostly safe — for now. Your value comes from judgment the machine doesn't have. But judgment is just a prompt the machine hasn't been given yet.
risk.analysisMedium: You're in the danger zone. Half your work is automatable and your company knows it. Start networking. Not LinkedIn networking. Real networking.
risk.analysisHigh: You're a prime candidate for replacement. Your tasks are pattern-heavy, your company is AI-curious, and your seniority doesn't protect you. Check our job board before the email arrives.
risk.analysisCritical: You are the machine's next meal. Your work is mostly AI-generated, nobody reviews it, and your company has an AI initiative with a budget. We'll save you a spot on the Wall.
